name: 3D Printing Holes
description: Holes made for 3D printing. Teardrop: select sketch circles, then run it; each gets a small tip a few percent of the diameter above it (it follows the diameter), so the top of a horizontal hole does not sag.

apply_to_all.title: Apply to all circles in sketch
apply_to_all.description: Off: convert only the selected sketch circles. On: convert every (non-construction) circle of the open sketch, no selection needed.

up.title: Up (tip direction)
up.description: Where the tip points. auto = world +Z (the print direction) projected into the sketch; +x, -x, +y, -y = sketch axes; angle = the angle below.

up_angle.title: Up angle (deg)
up_angle.description: Only with Up = angle: direction of the tip in degrees from sketch X (90 = sketch +Y).

warn_horizontal.title: Warn on horizontal sketch
warn_horizontal.description: With Up = auto on a horizontal sketch, world +Z gives no direction and the tip points to sketch +Y. Warn about it (turn off when the part prints in another orientation anyway).

tip_extra_d.title: Tip above circle (% of Ø)
tip_extra_d.description: How far the tip rises above the circle, in percent of the diameter: the hole gets this many percent of its diameter taller at the top. A few percent bridge the sagging top of a printed hole.

tip_height.title: Tip height
tip_height.description: Optional override: distance from the centre to the tip, in mm or an expression where r is the radius and d the diameter (e.g. d/2 + 0.3 mm, or d*sqrt(2)/2 for a classic 45 deg teardrop). Empty: from Tip above circle.
